title: NetworkFriendRequestedPayload
description: network.friend.requested v1 (plan §AB.51): `from` added `to` as a friend and `to` has not added `from`: a request `to` can accept (add back) or leave. Adding again what is already added sends nothing. Written to Network's outbox in the transaction that stores the change. Envelope: subject { type: user, id: <to> }, visibility subject, actor <from>.

revision.description: Grows with every change of this pair; apply the latest.
